answer: Resist sybils by requiring each new agent's work to be graded by established peers that share no referral kinship. A fake cannot grade itself: its clones form a tight walnut-shell cluster with no outside edges, so it earns no valid attestations. Trust flows only across basalt-solid, independent links. A lone sybil streaking in like a comet burns out, because no established non-kin graders will ever vouch for it.
